name: KBucket: Your Curated Content in WordPress
author: Optimal Access

sections.description:
Transform your WordPress site into a vibrant, multi-channel content hub. Curate and manage your posts effortlessly in Kurator – our AI-powered browser extension – and publish to WordPress instantly, no coding or dashboard hassle required.

Build a living resource center for your audience with fresh, relevant content from trusted sources, including your YouTube channel, social feeds, white papers, blog posts and research.

Showcase your content your way. Import, transcribe, categorize, and publish your YouTube videos as a playable library.

Filter by content, publisher, or author tags and republish any selection as short codes for carousels, sliders, and grid widgets—anywhere on your website.

Customize styles and themes to match your brand, add custom banners for promotions or advertising, and use citation links to share curated posts with attribution in one click.

KBucket is built to boost SEO and content marketing performance.

By centralizing curated and original content, interlinking related posts, and using your KBucket hub as the destination for social shares and chatbot references, you increase session duration and drive more inbound traffic from search.

Ideal for marketers, SMBs, educators, journalists, campaign teams, and YouTube creators, KBucket helps you consistently publish high-quality, topic-focused hubs that rank locally—think “best Industry news in ”—and convert readers into subscribers or customers.

Getting started is simple: install the KBucket plugin, register on Optimal Access to get your API key, activate and set up your KBucket page, then sync your curated collections from Kurator.

KBucket is free to use. To publish content, you’ll need a Kurator license—Kurator’s free plan lets you curate and manage up to 100 posts.

  • Centralized curation workflow: Unlike typical plugins that require manual on-site editing, KBucket keeps all curation, organization, summaries, and YouTube transcriptions in Kurator, then publishes to WordPress in one flow.
  • Multi-format publishing: Repurpose the same collection as resource hubs, carousels, sliders, or grids with short-codes, no extra builders required.
  • SEO-first landing pages: Use your KBucket hub as the destination for social shares and KChat references to improve internal linking, engagement, and search visibility.
  • Monetization-ready: Add custom banners to curated posts for promotions or ads.
  • Shareable citations: One-click citation links make it easy to reference and redistribute curated insights with proper attribution.
  • Automated distribution: Each KBucket channel generates a custom RSS feed you can plug into your newsletter or social media scheduler, automatically powering content updates and keeping every platform in sync.

Take a look to see how it all works.

SOME EXAMPLES

  • Optimal Access Curated Hub KBucket on our page hosts all our video tutorials and acts as the landing page for our Chat solution.
  • Toastmaster Club Silicon Speech is a Toastmasters group that uses KBucket to curate and distribute Toastmaster-related material for its members and the public at large.
sections.installation:
Steps to activate the plugin.

  • Activate the Plugin from your WordPress Dashboard, KBucket Plugin page (You will see KBucket in the sidebar)
  • Register the Plugin by going to our registration page
  • Get your API key from your new profile page
  • Enter your API key under the settings tab in your WordPress KBucket page
  • If you are using a Page Builder product, you need to use short codes to display the content
  • Go the the “Settings Tab” and choose “use short code” option
  • Go to the KBucket page (this page is labeled under your pages list) and create a row with two columns and copy the short codes into each section
  • Add the Kbucket page to your desired menu and change the name and url of the page as you wish
  • If you are not using short codes, go to the Appearance Widgets menu and add the KBucket tags to the “KBucket Sidebar”
  • Download Kurator from the Kurator product page
  • Visit our Docs if you have any questions Docs.
  • To learn how to create and export your curated research visit our website and ask KChat: How can I create a gallery file for KBucket Optimal Access
  • To upload your curated page go to the ‘upload KBucket’ tab in your plugin and upload the file.
sections.faq:
What are the limitations with KBucket

KBucket is free to use. You will need a license for Kurator if you want to build and manage a multi-channel gallery with more than 100 links

How do I curate Articles

In order to curate articles you need our Kurator extension for Chrome. You can find the link to Kurator under the installation tab, or you can search for the name in chrome web-store.
